name: Currency Taxonomy
description: Creates a 'currency' taxonomy vocabulary pre-populated with every ISO 4217 currency, each term carrying alphabetic ISO code, numeric code and country.
project_description: Currency Taxonomy creates a Drupal taxonomy vocabulary named 'currency' and, on install, populates it with a term for every ISO 4217 currency. Each term's name is in the 'Currency Name (ISO code)' format and carries three additional string fields: field_currency_iso (alphabetic ISO code), field_currency_number (numeric ISO code) and field_currency_country (country name). Terms are created from a bundled currency_codes.json file via hook_install(). The module ships a CurrencyTaxonomyService for programmatic lookup of currency terms by ISO code, numeric code or country, and a Drush command (currency-taxonomy:import) to wipe and re-import the term set. It has no admin UI or configuration form; the vocabulary and fields are provided as install-time configuration. Requires only core Taxonomy.
